annotations.title: Verify an AI Agent's Wallet (Know Your Agent, Free)

description: Run a Know-Your-Agent check on an AI agent's EVM wallet: ERC-8004 agent-registry lookup and operator, sanctions screening (result clear or sanctioned), on-chain behaviour (wallet age, activity, fund-flow taint, mixer and scam contacts, threat-intel alerts), a 0-100 risk score with its band (minimal, low, moderate, elevated, high or critical), and a signed W3C Verifiable Credential plus a sanctions-list Merkle proof that third parties can verify. Use it before paying, hiring or accepting payment from an autonomous agent, passing that agent's 0x wallet address; for an address on another chain, or a list-only check, use screen_wallet. Free, limited to 60 calls per minute per client; it reads public blockchain data live, so it can take several seconds and results change as the wallet transacts.

address.description: EVM wallet address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters

name: verify_agent_identity

fundFlow.description: taintLevel, hops traced, exposure and flagged paths; null when fund-flow tracing was unavailable

proofs.description: sanctionsList: signed RFC 6962 Merkle membership or non-membership proof

riskBand.description: Risk band derived from the score

threatIntel.description: Threat-intelligence matches; null when the feeds were unavailable

verifiableCredentials.description: compliance (and agentIdentity when registered) W3C Verifiable Credentials

walletProfile.description: walletAge, transactionCount, walletType, balances, known protocols, active chains; null when the chain lookup failed
